_doc: Long goals (clarity pass, docs/CLARITY.md §2): choosing a path at fourteen, the recruiter's test for the archers, an apprenticeship, saving for a better tool, courting. Placeholders: {years} {trade} {master} {recruiter} {price} {tool} {value} {pct} {name} {town} {shop}.
path.title: Choose your path
path.why: At fourteen the doors open: a trade with a master, a post, land of your own. What you have done by then decides which.
path.wait.hint: Meanwhile help at home, run errands and practise: stats and skills decide which doors will open.
path.think.hint: Hold E with nothing in front of you and choose 'Think about your career'.
path.reward: The career page: every door and what it asks
archer.title: Join the archers
archer.why: The lord's archers are paid by the day, fed from his table and respected. The recruiter wants strength, a true eye and a bow of your own.
archer.stat.hint: Heavy work builds strength: ploughing, felling, quarrying. Drawing a bow at the butts counts too.
archer.skill.hint: Hold E at the butts and choose 'Practise archery'. On holy days the whole village shoots.
archer.kit.hint: The carpenter makes bows; a shortbow is about 12d and the smith sells arrows.
archer.oath: Take the archers' oath: speak to {recruiter}
archer.oath.hint: Press E to talk, then ask for work and take the archer's post.
archer.reward: Opens the archers' company: daily pay and a place in the lord's host
apprentice.title: Win an apprenticeship with {master}
apprentice.why: A trade is a living for life. {master} takes apprentices, and a bound boy learns the craft in seven years.
apprentice.save.hint: Kin of the master pay nothing; others pay a premium. Sell goods, work for wages and do errands.
apprentice.talk.hint: Press E to talk and ask for work: the apprenticeship is offered in the list of posts.
apprentice.sign.hint: Choose the apprenticeship in the list of posts. You will live in the master's house and learn at the bench.
apprentice.reward: A trade, board and lodging, and the road to journeyman
tool.title: Save for {tool}
tool.why: {Tool} works about {pct} faster than the one you have, and everything you reap or make comes quicker.
tool.save.hint: Every coin counts: wages, errands and what you sell at market.
tool.buy.hint: Press E at the shop, choose Trade and buy it.
court.title: Find someone to love
court.why: You are of an age to marry. A spouse brings a household of your own, and children to carry the House on.
court.talk.hint: Talk to {name}. 'Pass the time of day' warms them; 'Court' opens compliments, walks and tokens.
court.progress.hint: In conversation choose 'Court' and pay compliments or ask them to walk out. A courtship takes days, and families must consent.
court.marry.hint: When they are won, 'Ask to marry you' appears in conversation. Parents' blessing may be needed.
court.reward: A spouse, and a household of your own
